scope: Spline radiative-model alternative rc_sf0, 3D RC_Bayesian only, on a copy of alternatives/spline/rc_sf0/histograms.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. The subtraction baseline is the refined event-yield RC under refinement_20261108/spline/nominal/rc, not fit_before_guide.json. No publication. The source ROOT file, alternatives, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json when this run started, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D RC spline B windows for these 452 histograms have median width 0.0126 and 436 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.0067 with 448 narrower than 0.05, so those windows can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the manual baseline and the corrected filled-window range.
